'''September 2001 Parker tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, Colorado on 15 September 2001. [[Chris Fanchi]] won it. It is known from Chris Fanchi's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2977">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-18-parker-co-9-15-01d2977/ parker-co-9-15-01], DeckTech (Chris "Artwo" Fanchi, 18 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-18-parker-co-9-15-01d2977/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 15 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Parker, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Episode I Closed Environment]]
* '''Players:''' 9
* '''Winner:''' [[Chris Fanchi]]
